verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a CLI that Claude Code, OpenClaw, and 'any agent that can run CLI commands' can use, plus a REST API and SDK. None of it shows a documented adapter for an agent framework such as the Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, or CrewAI. Generic CLI usage and coding-agent integrations are adjacent integration paths, not framework adapters, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can plug the browser layer into agent frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI) through documented adapters
